stories.summary: Iran's IRGC Navy and army navy say two to three tankers caught fire in or east of the Strait of Hormuz after hitting naval mines on unauthorised routes. The IRGC warned ships against cooperating with US forces, and its spokesman said mines await in the strait. UKMTO reported two suspicious tanker incidents.
